title: SMP Vector mod
description: SMP Vector. A social experiment disguised as a Minecraft mod.
body:
SMP Vector

A social experiment disguised as a Minecraft mod.

This mod is not about balance.
It’s not about progression.
And it’s definitely not about fairness.

SMP Vector introduces several independent vectors — systems that reshape how players interact with each other, with power, and with consequences.
Turn them on or off via gamerules. Combine them. Let them clash.

The result is not a “meta”.
The result is society.

🧬 Virus Vector

Every player receives one virus — permanently.
No rerolls. No second chances.

Viruses adapt, evolve, and lock you into a playstyle.
You don’t choose who you become — you survive as who you are.

Some evolve into tanks.
Some into shadows.
Some into things that shouldn’t exist for long.

🌀 Anomaly Vector

Reality becomes unreliable.

Damage reflects.
Positions shift.
Safe assumptions stop being safe.

Anomalies don’t ask if you’re ready — they just happen.
Sometimes to your enemy.
Sometimes to you.

✴️ Manifest Vector

Power born from will, sacrifice, and conflict.

Manifests are rare.
They only appear when one player kills another.
No farming. No automation.

Every manifest item is extreme, situational, and dangerous —
not just to others, but to the user as well.

🔗 Synergy Matters

Vectors don’t just coexist — they interact.

Virus + Anomaly
Anomaly + Manifest
Virus + Manifest
All three together

Some combinations create tools that can reset fights, erase positioning, or force entire groups to rethink their builds.

Nothing here is free.
Nothing here is safe.

👁️ What This Mod Is Really About

PvP with consequences

Ethics instead of balance

Long sessions with 5+ players

Emergent roles: scientists, extremists, hunters, opportunists

Chaos that comes from people, not RNG

There is no built-in lore.
No “chosen ones”.
No right way to play.

Only systems — and what players do with them.

If you want a mod where:

power always has a cost

survival changes people

and every conflict becomes a story

SMP Vector might be what you’re looking for.
